description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultDiagnosticLoggingAdapter class, which is part of the logging utilities in the Akka-based service framework. It verifies behavior like MDC handling, null checks, and message logging.

classes.name: DefaultDiagnosticLoggingAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultDiagnosticLoggingAdapter, testing MDC management, null argument handling, and message logging.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullLogger
methods.description: Tests that passing a null logging adapter throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullLoggerName
methods.description: Tests that passing null as logger name throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getInstanceWithBlankLoggerName
methods.description: Tests that passing an empty string as logger name throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: getNameReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the getName method returns the correct logger name.

methods.name: putTwoMdcEntriesLogDebugAndWarnThenDiscardMdcEntries
methods.description: Checks MDC entries are correctly set, used for logging, and then discarded.

methods.name: removeMdcEntryViaKey
methods.description: Tests removal of an MDC entry via its key, verifying MDC is updated appropriately.

methods.name: removeMdcEntryViaNullValue
methods.description: Tests that setting an MDC value to null removes it from MDC.
